2.3 Pro package
The Pro package costs EUR 199 per month excluding VAT. Pro allows up to 1,000 active listings at the same
time, ten users, CSV bulk upload and API access for automatic listing sync, 40 Top listing credits per month,
advanced statistics with CSV export and a dedicated onboarding call with a specialist. Pro suits professional
dealers, agencies and multi-location retailers. There is no free trial for Pro; instead, the first month can be
cancelled at any time within 30 days.
